tools.name: lucca_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with their identity, status and applicable employment and job position. Filter by name search, ids, email, status, legal entity, business establishment or department. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/employees (scope employees.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with the same fields as the employee list. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/employees/{id} (scope employees.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_employments
tools.description: List employments: the link between an employee and a legal entity, with start and end dates and status. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/employments (scope employments.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_get_employment
tools.description: Get one employment by id. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/employments/{id} (scope employments.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_job_positions
tools.description: List job positions: the role, business establishment, department, manager and dates of an employee's employment. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/job-positions (scope job-positions.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_legal_entities
tools.description: List legal entities (companies) of the account, with country and currency. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/legal-entities (scope legal-entities.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_business_establishments
tools.description: List business establishments (sites) with their legal entity, address and timezone. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/business-establishments (scope business-establishments.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_departments
tools.description: List departments of the account with their parent, level and manager. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/departments (scope departments.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_get_department
tools.description: Get one department by id. Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/departments/{id} (scope departments.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_list_taxonomy_labels
tools.description: List taxonomy labels: the values of the account's custom taxonomies (for example a job family list). Lucca API: GET /lucca-api/taxonomy-labels (scope taxonomies.readonly).

tools.name: lucca_create_department
tools.description: Create a department in the account. This adds a record that users can see; it cannot be undone from this tool. Lucca API: POST /lucca-api/departments (scope departments.readwrite).

tools.name: lucca_update_department
tools.description: Change the name or description of one department. Only the fields you pass are changed. Lucca API: PATCH /lucca-api/departments/{id} (scope departments.readwrite).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lucca_list_employees · Private data: lucca_create_department · Public sink: lucca_list_employees, lucca_create_department.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lucca_list_employees · Private data: lucca_create_department · Public sink: lucca_list_employees, lucca_create_department

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
